description: Source code implementing system property retrieval functions for Raspberry Pi, including reading device model info from /proc/device-tree/model and providing system properties such as brand name, model name, friendly name, and platform name.

methods.name: GetModelName
methods.description: Reads and extracts the Raspberry Pi model name from /proc/device-tree/model, removing revision info and trimming spaces.

methods.name: CopyStringAndTestIfSuccess
methods.description: Copies a string to an output buffer if it fits, returning success status.
